subject: Split LTL pickup - warehouse CFS cutoff and drayage rebooking
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Acme Events Ops <ops@acmeevents.com>, Hank Brooks <hank.brooks@freightwave.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Split LTL pickup - upcoming warehouse arrival and CFS instructions

Hi team,

Quick heads up on the booth crates bound for the Moscone Center: the shipment is consolidating into two LTL pallets at the CFS and will be delivered to the advance warehouse this Friday. Acme ops, please confirm the latest pickup window at your end and whether your preferred carrier needs a lift gate for both pallets. Our local drayage partner flagged the booking as split LTL which changes the terminal cutoff.

What we need by EOD today:
- Confirm warehouse arrival day and cutoff time
- Confirm lift gate requirement and pallet dimensions (height especially)
- Share final BOL and packing list so we can reconcile with the carrier manifest

I am attaching the current packing list used by the shipper. If any paperwork is missing we will rebook. Trying to avoid a CFS rework which would push the booth build back.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Events Program Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
(415) 555-0128

Attachment: packing_list_acme_20260901.xlsx (Excel, 48 KB)

From: Acme Events Ops <ops@acmeevents.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Hank Brooks <hank.brooks@freightwave.com>, Pacific Customs Broker <pbroker@pacificcb.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 12:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Split LTL pickup - upcoming warehouse arrival and CFS instructions

On Thu, Sep 2, 2026 at 10:12 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick heads up on the booth crates bound for the Moscone Center...

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the note. The CFS advised that the cutoff for split LTL loads is actually 1800 on Thursday due to a terminal gate window change; that is earlier than we were told last week. Our operations manager also noticed a discrepancy between the shipper BOL and the supplier packing list: the supplier marked one pallet as 48 x 40 x 96 but the shipper uploaded 48 x 40 x 78. If the higher height is correct we will need a lift gate and overheight handling.

I attached the shipper BOL we received and a photo of the crate labels. We can ask the trucker to hold at CFS for a short reweigh and measurement but that may incur demurrage if it misses the cutoff.

Pickup contact: Hank Brooks at FreightWave is copied and can confirm next available drayage slot.

Best,
Jules Park
Operations Lead, Acme Events
ops@acmeevents.com

Attachments: acme_bol_789.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB), crate_photo_3.jpg (JPEG, 350 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Acme Events Ops <ops@acmeevents.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Hank Brooks <hank.brooks@freightwave.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Split LTL pickup - upcoming warehouse arrival and CFS instructions

All,

I spoke with Hank this morning. FreightWave can rebook a same-day dray with a lift gate and overheight declaration but the next confirmed slot is Friday afternoon 1400-1700. That will meet the warehouse inbound window if the CFS can hold until 1700, otherwise we risk moving to the following business day with demurrage. Options:

1) Confirm actual pallet height now with the supplier and push corrected BOL to the CFS. If height is 96 we book lift gate and proceed with Friday 1400-1700.
2) If supplier cannot confirm, FreightWave recommends dropping one pallet to general carton handling and marking as fragiles to avoid overheight fees but this will require re-labelling at the CFS.

Action items I will do now:
- Hold a provisional booking with FreightWave for 4521 (no charge until confirmed)
- Open a brief SLA ticket with CFS to request hold until 1700 pending measurement
- Share updated booking docs to the drive folder once confirmed

Monica, can you ping the supplier and ask for an immediate confirmation of the pallet height? Lauren, can you prepare a one page waiver we can sign for the CFS to authorize hold if needed.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Logistics Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachment: freightwave_booking_4521.pdf (PDF, 58 KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Acme Events Ops <ops@acmeevents.com>, Hank Brooks <hank.brooks@freightwave.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Split LTL pickup - upcoming warehouse arrival and CFS instructions

Thanks everyone for the quick responses and for holding the provisional booking. Update: the supplier confirmed the taller crate at 96 high, so we must proceed with lift gate. Marcus, please finalize the FreightWave booking and send the Bill of Lading update to the CFS. Jules, Acme ops, please expect delivery window Friday 1400-1700 and advise the dock team to have a pallet jack plus a lift gate on standby.

We signed the CFS hold waiver and uploaded it to the shared drive. Final checklist before we close this ticket:
- Carrier to confirm pickup ETA to CFS on Friday by 10:00 PT
- Acme dock to confirm lift gate availability by 12:00 PT Friday
- FreightWave will send new BOL and carrier manifest to all parties once booking is confirmed

If any party sees a change I want to escalate to Marcus and me immediately so we can rebook alternative dray within the day.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Monica
Monica Patel
Events Program Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
(415) 555-0128
